# Tax Documentation: Retrieve Tax Documentation Document by ID

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`GET /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/document/{documentId}` · tenant-scoped token

Returns a generated PDF document by its ID for an Account Owner

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `documentId` | The Taxbit UUID for the Tax Documentation document. |

**Response 200**: Tax Documentation Document

Same fields as the response of [Generate Tax Documentation Document](generate-tax-documentation-document.md).

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
